scripts.predeploy: pnpm run config:production && vite build && node scripts/merge-wrangler-config.mjs production wrangler.deploy.json dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.json && vinext-cloudflare deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && wrangler preview --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.types: pnpm run config:local && wrangler types --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.migrations:apply:local: pnpm run config:local && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.migrations:apply: pnpm run config:production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.json

DB.description: Application database. A new D1 database is created on deploy; schema is applied by the deploy script.

ATTACHMENTS.description: Raw inbound message bodies and attachments.

NOTIFICATIONS.description: Live inbox notifications. One Durable Object namespace, created with the Worker.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs dashboard sessions. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Optional. If set, first-run setup requires it, so nobody else can claim the admin account before you. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 16`.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token used to create sending domains and Email Routing rules. Needs Email Sending and Email Routing edit on this account.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID. Dashboard → Workers & Pages → Account ID.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public origin used in unsubscribe links. Change this after you attach a custom domain.

INBOX_WORKER_NAME.description: Worker name Email Routing should deliver to. Keep this equal to the Worker name. Override both in wrangler.local.jsonc when this install uses a different name.
